北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天冷，体感 -9℃，外出务必多穿防风保暖衣物哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is very windy and cold, feels like -9℃. Bundle up warmly when you go out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力较大，体感 7℃，早晚出行记得添衣，注意保暖！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is quite windy, feels like 7℃. Remember to add layers in the morning and evening!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 9℃，早晚微凉。出门别忘带件外套哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 9℃. It's a bit cool, don't forget your jacket!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗，体感 16℃，早晚风大略凉，记得加件薄外套哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny, feels like 16℃. Breezy and a bit cool in the morning/evening, bring a light jacket!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴好，体感 18℃，舒适宜人。享受这美好的天气吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant, feels like 18℃. Enjoy the beautiful weather!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州风力不小，体感 8℃。注意防风，早晚添衣别着凉哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is quite windy, feels like 8℃. Mind the wind, add clothes in the morning/evening!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京天阴风大，体感 1℃。出门请务必穿厚实些，小心感冒！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and windy, feels like 1℃. Dress warmly when you go out to avoid catching a cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗，体感 12℃，天气舒适。记得多喝水保持健康哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and comfortable, feels like 12℃. Remember to drink water and stay healthy!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 9℃。早晚凉意浓，记得添衣别着凉！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 9℃. It's cool in the morning/evening, remember to dress warmly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 6℃，空气干燥。请注意补水保湿，多喝水哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels like 6℃, and the air is dry. Remember to hydrate and moisturize!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，体感 9℃。外出请注意防护，多喝水，保重身体！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, feels like 9℃. Take protective measures if you go out, and stay hydrated!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -23℃！出门务必全副武装，注意防寒保暖哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -23℃! Make sure to bundle up completely and stay warm!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -23℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 -17℃，风力较大。出门记得戴帽子手套，别冻着！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -17℃ and is quite windy. Remember your hat and gloves when going out!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 11℃。风力不小，早晚外出请注意添衣哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 11℃. It's a bit windy, remember to add layers in the morning/evening!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 11℃。风力较大，早晚记得加件外套哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 11℃. It's windy, remember to bring a jacket in the morning/evening!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云风大，体感 -6℃。寒风刺骨，务必多穿防寒衣物！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and windy, feels like -6℃. The biting wind is chilly, dress very warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云风大，体感 -10℃。外出请戴好帽子手套，谨防冻伤！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and windy, feels like -10℃. Wear your hat and gloves when going out to prevent frostbite!
